US issues landmark construction permit for Texas SMR plant
articles.원문 요약: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a construction permit for the proposed plant featuring four Xe-100 small modular reactor units at Dow's Seadrift site - the first construction permit for a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor issued in the USA in nearly 60 years.

articles.제목: Fourth Hualong One under construction at San'ao site
articles.원문 요약: The first concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 4 of the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province, China General Nuclear has announced.

articles.제목: Uzbekistan plans to double uranium production
articles.원문 요약: Uzbekistan is planning to double its uranium production by 2030 - and the country's president has said state mining company Navoiyuran must make the most of alternative production technologies to help do this.

articles.제목: Largest remediation project at UK's Harwell site completed
articles.원문 요약: Nuclear Restoration Services has announced the completion of remediation works of former liquid effluent treatment facilities at the UK's Harwell nuclear research site, restoring 4.2 hectares of land at the Oxfordshire site.

Dome installed at Pakistan's Chashma unit 5
articles.원문 요약: The inner safety dome has been installed on the containment building of unit 5 at the Chashma nuclear power plant site in Pakistan.

articles.제목: OPG set to revise timeline and cost of first SMR unit
articles.원문 요약: The first of four BWRX-300 small modular reactors under construction at the Darlington New Nuclear Project will not be completed within the previously planned timeline or cost, Ontario Power Generation has said.

articles.제목: Russia proposes carbon credits framework for SMRs
articles.원문 요약: An international methodology to allow small modular reactors to qualify for carbon credits under the terms of the Paris Agreement has been proposed to the UN's climate/COP secretariat by Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom.

articles.제목: Study analyses economic impact of Greek nuclear power plant
articles.원문 요약: The construction of a 1,600 MW nuclear power plant could contribute about EUR4.5 billion (USD5 billion) to Greece's gross domestic product over the full construction period, according to a new study.
